title: rumble-pro-wrestling-2004-world
label: Justin Kell

won.source: Billed throughout Initiation Rites (10 April 2004) and every later served broadcast as the reigning champion since a first-ever Rumble Pro World Title match; no primary-source transcript of that 28 March 2004 show survives in the held record.

how: Won the promotion's own first World Heavyweight Championship match, per its own later broadcasts' commentary; no surviving document in the held record names the challenger or the finish.

title: rumble-pro-wrestling-2004-tag-team
label: Real Xtreme

won.source: Initiation Rites, 10 April 2004: Real Xtreme (Lance Williams and James Robinson) beat Werewolf Gregorson and Travis LaGrange in the final of a one-night, nine-team tournament to become the promotion's own first Tag Team Champions.

how: James Robinson pinned Werewolf Gregorson with a top-rope spike piledriver after Lance Williams knocked Travis LaGrange off the apron, with Chris Chronic as special guest referee.
